subject: Piece of Heart
text: As Adult Link, jump along the icebergs from the first iceberg in Zora's Fountain to the east branch to get a Piece of Heart at the end of the string.

evidence.quote:
Head for the first iceberg in Zora's Fountain, and jump out along the icebergs
until you reach the huge one.  The icebergs branch north and east from here.
Run to the east iceberg, and run out to the end of the string of icebergs to
get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: As Adult Link, equip the Iron Boots and sink to the very bottom of the pool in Zora's Fountain to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Iron Boots and sink to the very bottom of the pool.  The Piece of
Heart lies at the bottom.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In the Ice Cavern room with the large spinning ice scythe, melt the east wall with blue fire to find a small room and use a Bottle of Blue Fire to melt the red ice containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head for the room with the large spinning scythe made of ice.  On the east side
of the room, there is a wall which can be melted with blue fire.  Go through
this wall, and on the other side you'll find a small room.  In this room, there
is a chunk of red ice.  The Piece of Heart is inside it.  Use a Bottle of Blue
Fire to melt the red ice.

subject: Fishing Minigame
text: As Young Link, speak to the clerk at the Lake Hylia Fishing Pond and pay him 20 rupees to play the Fishing Minigame.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, go to the Fishing Pond in Lake Hylia.  Speak with the Clerk to
the right, and pay him 20 rupees to play the Fishing Minigame.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Catch a record-breaking fish of at least nine pounds in the Fishing Minigame and show it to the clerk to receive a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In order to win the Piece of Heart, you have to capture a record breaking fish:
nine pounds...Once you have captured a nine-pound fish (minimum), return to the Clerk and
show him your fish.  He'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Plant a Magic Bean behind the Observatory as Young Link, then as Adult Link ride the Magic Leaf or use the Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot to reach the roof and climb the ladder to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, plant a Magic Bean in the patch of soft earth near the backside
of the Observatory.  Back as Adult Link, ride the Magic Leaf to the roof of the
observatory, and from there climb the ladder to the top of the tower.  The
Heart Piece is on top.  Alternatively, you can also reach the roof using the
Scarecrow's Song and Hookshot.

subject: Gold Scale
text: Adult Link can win the Gold Scale from the Fishing Pond by catching a fifteen-pound or larger fish.

evidence.quote:
First, win the Gold Scale from the Fishing Pond by catching a fifteen-pound or
larger fish with Adult Link.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Dive all the way down to the bottom of the observatory pool with the Gold Scale and speak with the scientist to receive a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Then, go to the observatory and jump into the
pool of water.  Dive all the way down to the bottom of the pool, then speak
with the scientist.  He'll give you a Piece of Heart for your accomplishment.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Glide down with a Cucco as Young Link or use the Longshot as Adult Link to reach a cliff ledge in Gerudo Valley, then roll into the crate to find a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, grab a Cucco and glide down to the ledge on the far wall of the
cliff.  It has a crate sitting on it.  Roll into the crate to find a Piece of
Heart.  Alternatively, you can also use the Longshot with Adult Link.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: In Gerudo Valley, glide with a Cucco behind the waterfall at the east end of the canyon and climb the ladder behind it to reach a Piece of Heart at the top.

evidence.quote:
Grab a Cucco, and use it to float down to the backside of the waterfall at the
east end of the canyon.  Land in the water behind the waterfall, where there is
no current, and climb up the ladder behind the waterfall.  The Piece of Heart
is at the top of the ladder.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: On the top floor of Gerudo Fortress, use the Longshot to reach the chest on the north side to obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Head to the top floor of Gerudo Fortress.  Look to the north side of the
fortress, where you will see the chest.  Use the Longshot to pull yourself over
to it.  Open the chest to get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Score at least 1,000 points in the Horseback Archery Minigame using twenty arrows to win a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
You get twenty arrows to use, and in order to win the Piece
of Heart from this game you must score at least 1,000 points...Once you score 1,000 points, you'll win the Piece of Heart.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Plant a Magic Bean near the Spirit Temple entrance as Young Link, then return as Adult Link and ride the Magic Leaf to reach a Piece of Heart on top of an archway.

evidence.quote:
As Young Link, play the Requiem of Spirit to warp to the Desert Colossus.  Run
to the entrance to the Spirit Temple, where you will find a patch of soft earth
just to it's left.  Plant the Magic Bean here.  Become Adult Link, and return
to the Desert Colossus.  Use the Magic Leaf to float around the Desert
Colossus, and near the end of it's path you'll pass by an archway.  Jump on top
of it, and you'll find the Piece of Heart on top of the arch.
